ai_opportunities.name: AI Customer Service Chatbot
ai_opportunities.description: AI-powered chatbot that handles common customer inquiries 24/7 including order status, shipping questions, returns, and product recommendations

value_saved.description: Reduces support ticket volume by handling 40-60% of inquiries automatically

value_created.description: 24/7 instant customer support, improved CSAT scores, faster response times
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 5-10% increase in conversion from instant answers to pre-purchase questions

custom_solution.approach: Custom AI chatbot using Claude API integrated with your order management and product database
pros: Fully customized to your brand voice

roi_example.scenario: E-commerce store handling 500 support tickets/week, 3 support agents
roi_example.value_created: Automate 40-60% of tickets, reduce support headcount or reallocate to high-value tasks
roi_example.assumptions: Not all ticket types can be automated; complex issues still need human agents; setup and training period of 2-4 weeks

jevons_effect.mechanism: Faster support response times lead to higher customer satisfaction, which increases repeat purchases and referrals
jevons_effect.demand_expansion_potential: 15% increase in repeat purchase rate from improved support experience

agent_opportunity.what_it_does: Handles tier-1 support tickets: order status, return policy, shipping questions, FAQs. Pulls real-time order data from Shopify to personalize every response. Starts in draft mode (agent suggests, human approves) and graduates to autonomous for routine queries.
prerequisites: Support tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, or email inbox)

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Generated Product Descriptions & Content
ai_opportunities.description: Use AI to generate compelling product descriptions, titles, meta tags, and marketing copy at scale

value_saved.description: Eliminate manual copywriting for standard product listings

value_created.description: Faster product launches, SEO-optimized content, consistent brand voice
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 10-20% improvement in organic search traffic from better SEO content

custom_solution.approach: Custom content pipeline using Claude API with brand-specific fine-tuning and direct CMS integration

roi_example.scenario: Store with 500 products needing descriptions, adding 20 new products/month
roi_example.value_created: Reduce content creation time from 30 min to 5 min per product
roi_example.assumptions: AI-generated content still needs human review; brand voice consistency requires initial setup

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Powered Abandoned Cart Recovery
ai_opportunities.description: Multi-channel abandoned cart recovery using AI-optimized timing, messaging, and personalized incentives

value_saved.description: Automated recovery campaigns replace manual follow-up

value_created.description: Recover 10-15% of abandoned carts through personalized multi-channel outreach
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 5-15% increase in revenue from recovered carts

custom_solution.approach: Custom recovery system with AI-personalized messaging, dynamic discount offers, and multi-channel orchestration

roi_example.scenario: Store with EUR 100K/month revenue, 70% cart abandonment rate
roi_example.value_created: Recover abandoned carts through automated email and SMS sequences
roi_example.assumptions: Recovery rates depend on product type, price point, and existing email marketing maturity

agent_opportunity.what_it_does: Monitors abandoned carts in real-time. Sends personalized recovery sequences across email and SMS with AI-optimized timing and dynamic incentives based on cart value and customer history.

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Powered Product Recommendations
ai_opportunities.description: Personalized product recommendations on site, in emails, and during checkout based on browsing and purchase behavior

value_saved.description: Replace manual merchandising and cross-sell setup

value_created.description: Increase AOV through relevant upsells and cross-sells, improve customer experience

custom_solution.approach: Custom recommendation engine using collaborative filtering and purchase data analysis

roi_example.value_created: Increase AOV through personalized upsells and cross-sells
roi_example.assumptions: AOV lift varies by catalog size and product diversity; requires minimum traffic for algorithm effectiveness

jevons_effect.mechanism: Better recommendations lead to more browsing, more product discovery, and larger baskets
jevons_effect.demand_expansion_potential: 20% increase in pages viewed per session

ai_opportunities.name: AI Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
ai_opportunities.description: AI-powered demand prediction to optimize inventory levels, reduce stockouts, and minimize overstock

value_saved.description: Eliminate manual inventory planning and spreadsheet forecasting

value_created.description: Reduce stockouts (lost sales) and overstock (tied-up capital), improve cash flow
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 5-10% revenue increase from fewer stockouts + 20-30% less capital in excess inventory

custom_solution.approach: Custom ML demand forecasting model trained on your sales data, incorporating external factors (weather, trends, marketing calendar)

roi_example.scenario: Store with EUR 500K inventory, 8% stockout rate, 25% overstock
roi_example.value_created: Reduce stockouts and optimize inventory levels
roi_example.assumptions: Forecast accuracy depends on data quality and product type; new products lack historical data for prediction

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Powered Dynamic Pricing
ai_opportunities.description: Automatically adjust prices based on demand, competition, inventory levels, and customer segments

value_saved.description: Eliminate manual competitive price checking and adjustment

value_created.description: Optimize margins across catalog, respond to market changes in real-time

required_data: Historical sales at different price points

cons: Limited SKU counts on lower tiers

custom_solution.approach: Custom pricing engine using ML models trained on your sales data and competitive intelligence

roi_example.scenario: Store with 1,000 SKUs, EUR 2M annual revenue, 25% average margin
roi_example.value_created: Optimize pricing across catalog to maximize margins while remaining competitive
roi_example.assumptions: Dynamic pricing works best with large catalogs and sufficient competition data; may not suit luxury/brand-image-focused products

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Powered Email Marketing Automation
ai_opportunities.description: Automated lifecycle email flows with AI-optimized content, timing, and segmentation

value_saved.description: Automate campaign creation, segmentation, and optimization

value_created.description: Higher email revenue through personalization and optimal timing
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: Email should drive 25-40% of total e-commerce revenue

custom_solution.approach: Custom email system with AI-generated content, predictive send times, and advanced segmentation

roi_example.scenario: Store with 20,000 email subscribers, currently generating 15% of revenue from email
roi_example.value_created: Increase email revenue contribution from 15% to 25-35% through automated flows
roi_example.assumptions: Results depend on list quality, product type, and existing email maturity

ai_opportunities.name: Automated Review Collection & Management
ai_opportunities.description: Systematically collect, manage, and respond to product reviews to build social proof and improve SEO

value_saved.description: Automated review requests, AI response drafting, no manual follow-up

value_created.description: More reviews increase conversion rates, SEO rankings, and customer trust
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: Products with reviews convert 270% better than those without

custom_solution.approach: Custom review collection system with AI sentiment analysis and automated response generation

roi_example.scenario: Store with 200 products, averaging 2 reviews per product
roi_example.value_created: Increase review volume to improve conversion rates and SEO
roi_example.assumptions: Review impact on conversion varies by product category; photo reviews have higher impact than text-only

agent_opportunity.what_it_does: Monitors new reviews across platforms, drafts personalized responses matching your brand voice, flags negative reviews for human attention. Runs daily review sweeps automatically.
prerequisites: Review platform (Yotpo, Judge.me, or Google Business)

not_recommended.name: Building a custom e-commerce platform
not_recommended.reason: Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce are mature and cost-effective; custom platforms cost 10-100x more to build and maintain
not_recommended.alternative: Use established platforms and customize with apps/plugins

not_recommended.name: Custom fraud detection system
not_recommended.reason: Fraud patterns evolve constantly; established providers have larger datasets for training ML models
not_recommended.alternative: Use Shopify Protect, Signifyd, or Riskified for fraud prevention

not_recommended.name: Building your own email marketing platform
not_recommended.reason: Email deliverability, compliance (GDPR/CAN-SPAM), and infrastructure are complex; established platforms handle this
not_recommended.alternative: Use Klaviyo, Omnisend, or Mailchimp with custom integrations
